label: a thousand
ledger: The first thousand. The lamp is warm. — K.

label: a million
ledger: A million arrangements. My predecessor said this takes a year by hand. It took an evening.

label: a billion
ledger: More orderings than there are people. Each one a hand no one has ever held.

label: neurons in a brain
ledger: About as many as the thoughts you could have about them.

label: a trillion
ledger: The deck does most of this now. I mostly watch.

label: grains of sand on Earth's beaches
ledger: Every grain. I have never been to a beach with this many.

label: a sextillion
ledger: The old ledgers stop here. The Keeper before me ran out of ink, or patience.

label: atoms in a human body
ledger: You, arranged every way. Most of them would not be you.

label: a nonillion
ledger: A nonillion. The word sounds made up. It isn't.

label: past easy naming
ledger: Somewhere here the counting stops feeling like counting.

label: atoms in the Earth
ledger: The whole planet, one atom per arrangement. Still not close.

label: atoms in the solar system
ledger: I have started to suspect the lamp is not a lamp.
Every hand. Every one. — And there is a knock at the door.

label: atoms in the observable universe
ledger: The new deck has a card I don't recognise.
